company_name: Dongguan Ritec Sealing Technology Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company specializes in sealing solutions that are applicable in semiconductor manufacturing but does not directly supply semiconductor materials or equipment.
summary: Dongguan Ritec Sealing Technology Co., Ltd manufactures high-end rubber and plastic seals that are utilized in various applications, including semiconductor integrated circuits. The company emphasizes quality and innovation in its production processes, providing tailored sealing solutions to meet customer needs.

regional_presence.China: The company is located in Dongguan City, Guangdong Province, and serves both domestic and international markets.
